# Schema `register`

The item register: kinds and their inspection rules, items, kit sets, photos, asset-number counters and spreadsheet imports (Sprint 2).

## `register.asset_counters`

The last generated asset number for each prefix, so generated numbers never repeat. Bookkeeping: changes are not audited, the number shows on the item that took it.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | References | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no | `uuid_v7()` |  | Row id, a UUIDv7. |
| `prefix` | text | no |  |  | Asset-number prefix, upper-case letters and digits. |
| `last_number` | integer | no | `0` |  | The highest number issued for the prefix. |

## `register.imports`

Spreadsheet imports of items. Organisation-level: the service lets a person see their own imports and Kit Managers all of them. The check report lists every problem by row and column; items are stored only when nothing is wrong.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | References | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no | `uuid_v7()` |  | Primary key, a UUIDv7 (time-ordered). |
| `file_name` | text | no |  |  | The uploaded file's name, for display only. |
| `file_format` | text | no |  |  | csv or xlsx, decided from the file. |
| `stored_name` | text | no |  |  | Where the file is under the files directory (imports/). |
| `byte_size` | integer | no |  |  | Size of the uploaded file in bytes. |
| `status` | text | no | `'queued'::text` |  | queued (waiting for the worker or a check), checking, problems (the file has errors; nothing stored), ready (clean, waiting to be stored), loading, loaded or failed. |
| `row_count` | integer | no | `0` |  | Rows read, not counting the header. |
| `items_loaded` | integer | no | `0` |  | Items stored; 0 unless loaded. |
| `report` | jsonb | no | `'{}'::jsonb` |  | The check report: file-level problems and problems by row and column. |
| `error` | text | yes |  |  | Why the import failed (a fault, not a problem in the file). |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row was created (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `created_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who created the row; null for system jobs and migrations. Set by trigger. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row last changed (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `updated_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who last changed the row; null for system jobs. Set by trigger. |
| `row_version` | integer | no | `1` |  | Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every update. Office edits send it back for optimistic locking. |

## `register.item_photos`

Photos of items (not of people), at most 10 per item. The file is on the files volume with its metadata (EXIF, GPS) stripped; it is served only through a permission check. Removing a photo deletes the row (audited). _(row-level security)_

| Column | Type | Null | Default | References | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no | `uuid_v7()` |  | Primary key, a UUIDv7 (time-ordered). |
| `site_id` | uuid | no |  | `core.sites` | Site the row belongs to (row-level security key, DB-06). |
| `item_id` | uuid | no |  | `register.items` | Item photographed, in the same depot. |
| `content_type` | text | no |  |  | image/jpeg, image/png or image/webp, decided from the file's bytes, never its name. |
| `byte_size` | integer | no |  |  | Stored size in bytes after metadata was stripped; at most 10 MB. |
| `width` | integer | no |  |  | Width in pixels. |
| `height` | integer | no |  |  | Height in pixels. |
| `sha256` | text | no |  |  | SHA-256 of the stored file, so a download can be checked. |
| `storage_key` | text | no |  |  | Where the file is under the files directory. |
| `thumb_key` | text | yes |  |  | Where the thumbnail is; null until the worker has made it (the page shows the full photo meanwhile). |
| `thumb_failed` | boolean | no | `false` |  | True if the worker could not make a thumbnail (a WebP, or a file it could not decode); the page then shows the stored photo. |
| `sort_order` | integer | no | `0` |  | Display order, lowest first; the first is the item's main photo. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row was created (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `created_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who created the row; null for system jobs and migrations. Set by trigger. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row last changed (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `updated_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who last changed the row; null for system jobs. Set by trigger. |
| `row_version` | integer | no | `1` |  | Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every update. Office edits send it back for optimistic locking. |

## `register.items`

Every tool and piece of equipment the organisation owns or has hired in. Site-owned (home depot). Retired, never deleted. A kit (is_kit) holds items one level deep. _(row-level security)_

| Column | Type | Null | Default | References | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no | `uuid_v7()` |  | Primary key, a UUIDv7 (time-ordered). |
| `site_id` | uuid | no |  | `core.sites` | Site the row belongs to (row-level security key, DB-06). |
| `kind_id` | uuid | no |  | `register.kinds` | Kind of item; its inspection rules come from the kind. |
| `asset_number` | text | no |  |  | The number on the label, unique across the organisation ignoring case. Generated (PREFIX-000123) or typed in. |
| `serial_number` | text | yes |  |  | Maker's serial number, as printed. |
| `make` | text | yes |  |  | Maker. |
| `model` | text | yes |  |  | Model. |
| `description` | text | yes |  |  | What the item is, in plain words. |
| `purchase_date` | date | yes |  |  | Date bought; null if unknown. |
| `cost_pence` | bigint | yes |  |  | Purchase cost in whole pence (exact: never a float); null if unknown. |
| `ownership` | text | no | `'owned'::text` |  | owned, or hired_in from another company. |
| `hire_company` | text | yes |  |  | Company the item is hired from; required when hired in, empty when owned. |
| `hire_reference` | text | yes |  |  | The hire company's agreement or contract reference. |
| `off_hire_date` | date | yes |  |  | Date the item is due to go back to the hire company. |
| `location_id` | uuid | yes |  | `core.locations` | Where the item is now (a store, van, yard or job site of the same depot); null if not placed yet. |
| `status` | text | no | `'available'::text` |  | available, out, quarantined, missing or retired. Transitions are enforced by a trigger; Sprint 2 sets only available and retired, later sprints set the rest. |
| `retired_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  | When the item was retired; set with retired_reason. |
| `retired_reason` | text | yes |  |  | Why the item was retired (sold, scrapped, failed beyond repair...). |
| `is_kit` | boolean | no | `false` |  | True if the item is a kit (a harness set) that holds other items. A kit can't itself be inside a kit. |
| `parent_id` | uuid | yes |  | `register.items` | The kit this item is part of, in the same depot; null if it is not in a kit. Kits are one level deep. |
| `label_version` | smallint | no | `1` |  | Version of the label code: replacing a lost or copied label adds one, so every older print stops working. |
| `attributes` | jsonb | no | `'{}'::jsonb` |  | Kind-specific details (a ladder's rated height, a sling's working load limit) as a JSON object (DB-16). |
| `notes` | text | yes |  |  | Free-text notes. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row was created (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `created_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who created the row; null for system jobs and migrations. Set by trigger. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row last changed (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `updated_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who last changed the row; null for system jobs. Set by trigger. |
| `row_version` | integer | no | `1` |  | Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every update. Office edits send it back for optimistic locking. |

## `register.kind_rules`

The inspection rules a kind carries: the customer's own schedule settings, editable defaults, not legal advice. Sprint 4 builds schedules from them; Sprint 2 stores and shows them. Removing a rule deletes the row (audited).

| Column | Type | Null | Default | References | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no | `uuid_v7()` |  | Primary key, a UUIDv7 (time-ordered). |
| `kind_id` | uuid | no |  | `register.kinds` | Kind the rule belongs to. |
| `rule_type` | text | no |  |  | loler (thorough examination), puwer (inspection), pat (portable appliance test), calibration, pre_use (user check before use) or other. |
| `title` | text | no |  |  | What the rule is called on screens, for example "Thorough examination". |
| `interval_value` | integer | no |  |  | How many days or months between occurrences. |
| `interval_unit` | text | no |  |  | days or months. |
| `required` | boolean | no | `false` |  | True if the customer treats the rule as required for this kind. |
| `note` | text | yes |  |  | Why the default is what it is and who should confirm it (a competent person). |
| `sort_order` | integer | no | `0` |  | Display order, lowest first. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row was created (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `created_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who created the row; null for system jobs and migrations. Set by trigger. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row last changed (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `updated_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who last changed the row; null for system jobs. Set by trigger. |
| `row_version` | integer | no | `1` |  | Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every update. Office edits send it back for optimistic locking. |

## `register.kinds`

Kinds of item (power tool, ladder, harness...) and the inspection rules each carries. Organisation-wide. A kind in use is deactivated, never deleted (the foreign key from items refuses it).

| Column | Type | Null | Default | References | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no | `uuid_v7()` |  | Primary key, a UUIDv7 (time-ordered). |
| `name` | text | no |  |  | Kind name as staff know it, unique ignoring case. |
| `description` | text | yes |  |  | What the kind covers. |
| `asset_prefix` | text | yes |  |  | Prefix for generated asset numbers of this kind (for example FB gives FB-000123); null uses the organisation default prefix setting. |
| `active` | boolean | no | `true` |  | False once deactivated: no new items of this kind, existing ones stay. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row was created (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `created_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who created the row; null for system jobs and migrations. Set by trigger. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row last changed (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `updated_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who last changed the row; null for system jobs. Set by trigger. |
| `row_version` | integer | no | `1` |  | Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every update. Office edits send it back for optimistic locking. |
